details: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reportedly requested a plan to explore the use of blockchain technology to help Israel circumvent potential international financial sanctions. These remarks come as he warned about the possibility of banking restrictions and the eventual end of significant US military aid. The proposal highlights cryptocurrency's potential role in navigating geopolitical challenges and could increase its perceived utility on a state level.
title: Netanyahu Eyes Crypto to Counter Sanctions Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The upcoming US Midterm Elections on November 3, 2026, are drawing attention from crypto investors due to their potential impact on economic policies, regulatory decisions, and overall investor sentiment. Historical data suggests that Bitcoin has experienced significant declines in the fourth quarter during previous midterm election years. Analysts are warning of potential volatility for Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and the broader crypto market as shifting political expectations regarding crypto regulation and taxation emerge.
title: US Midterm Elections 2026: Crypto Volatility Expected

details: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to create significant volatility across global financial markets. Oil prices have surged to a five-month high amid persistent concerns over supply disruptions and the prolonged conflict involving Iran. While major equity markets have shown some resilience, underlying geopolitical risks remain prominent. Analysts are closely watching for potential escalations post-US midterm elections, with reports indicating increasing profit warnings for UK firms partly attributed to the impact of the Iran conflict.
title: Middle East Tensions Drive Oil Prices Up, Global Stocks Wobble
